data.title: The leaderboard shows the lowest scores
story: The function top_three(scores) must return the three HIGHEST scores, biggest first.
Right now it shows the three lowest. Try print() on the sorted() result to see the order.

explanation: sorted() orders from small to big, so the first three are the lowest scores. Add reverse=True to order from big to small, then take the first three.
hints: Add print(ordered) before return. Is it small to big or big to small?
sorted() has an option reverse=True to flip the order.
